units.english: The origin of this Wardragon is shrouded in mystery. It was said that the Quarg once used this ship as a powerful light warship. Other sources suggest that it was used as a front-line heavy warship. One thing is for certain though, and that's its design is far different than any Quarg ship that exists today, and one can only question where it came from.

units.english: This ship appears to be a hollowed-out asteroid filled with strange equipment. It is unclear what is creating the rays of light, but they must have something to do with how it moves without obvious engines.

units.english: Never underestimate the power of a bunch of crystals on a rock. In this case all they do is project some harmless purple rays around the Shooting Star, but the point still stands.
